copy.html:
We want to make sure that you have an excellent chance of hitting the jackpot, and that’s why paying for your LottosOnline lottery tickets could not be easier.

You can choose to top up your LottosOnline Account Balance at any time, using a credit or debit card. This balance can then be used to buy tickets whenever you like. Alternatively, you can pay directly at the checkout by credit card. Use whichever is easiest for you.

However you choose to pay, please note that payment must clear before we process your order. Please contact us at [email protected] if you have further questions. We are always happy to help!

No further questions? Then why not hedge your bets and strike it lucky?
